name: infinity-loader
title: Infinity Loader
description: An SVG infinity-path loader: a single stroke-dash loop that runs continuously, with a springy "hop-away" exit animation. Reduced-motion aware. Zero deps, SVG inline.
tagline: Continuous ∞ stroke-dash spinner that persists across navigations, then hops away.
registration: exports InfinityLoader AND self-registers — drop <infinity-loader> (optional `auto`); JS also exposes InfinityLoader.show()
